item.title: Haeundae to Haedong Yonggungsa by Bus: Take No. 181 to Yonggungsa Entrance (Every 20 Minutes)
item.description: It’s bus 181. Take city bus 181 from Haeundae Station (해운대역) on subway Line 2, get off at “Yonggungsa Entrance (용궁사 입구)” and walk from there to Haedong Yonggungsa Temple (해동용궁사). The bus comes every 20 minutes. If you hate transfers, this is the simplest way to go. (Official Haedong Yonggungsa website and Visit Busan, the Busan Tourism Organization’s site, checked November 26, 2026.)

item.title: Busan Station to Haeundae by Subway: 46 Minutes, ₩1,800, One Transfer at Seomyeon
item.description: It takes 46 minutes and costs ₩1,800 with a transit card. At Busan Station (부산역), get on Line 1 bound for Nopo (노포), change once at Seomyeon Station (서면역) to Line 2 bound for Jangsan (장산), and you’re at Haeundae Station (해운대역). From Exit 5 it’s another 15 minutes on foot to Haeundae Beach (해운대해수욕장), so allow a little over an hour from the ticket gates at Busan Station to the sand. (Fares checked November 19, 2026 and travel time checked November 9, both with Busan Transportation Corporation.)

item.title: Busan Metro Guide 2026: Fares (₩1,600), 1-Day Pass (₩6,000), Bus Transfers & Last Trains
item.description: One transit card is all you need for the Busan subway. There are only two fares, ₩1,600 for trips up to 10 km and ₩1,800 for anything longer, and the discount for changing to a bus applies to cards only. The QR tickets sold at station machines cost ₩100 more per ride and get no transfer discount. The numbers below are from the Busan Transportation Corporation website, checked on November 18, 2026.

item.title: Gimhae Airport to Busan Station, Seomyeon & Haeundae: Light Rail + Subway from ₩1,600, Limousine Bus Times, Taxi Fares
item.description: From Gimhae International Airport (김해국제공항), the standard way into Busan is the light rail to Sasang Station (사상역), then subway Line 2. With a transit card it takes about 26 minutes and ₩1,600 to Seomyeon (서면), about 39 minutes and ₩1,800 to Busan Station (부산역), and about 56 minutes and ₩1,800 to Haeundae (해운대). With a lot of luggage the limousine bus is easier (₩6,000 to Seomyeon, ₩9,500 to Haeundae), but the last one leaves in the 21:00 hour, so you will miss it if you land on a late flight. The numbers below are from the Busan-Gimhae Light Rail, Busan Transportation Corporation, and Korea Airports Corporation’s Gimhae Airport pages, checked on November 13, 2026.

item.title: Busan Station to Haeundae (2026): Subway in 46 Min for ₩1,800, Express Bus 1003, Taxi Fares & Last Trains
item.description: The subway from Busan Station (부산역) to Haeundae Station (해운대역) takes 46 minutes and costs ₩1,800 with a transit card. You ride Line 1, change once at Seomyeon Station (서면역), and finish on Line 2. If you would rather stay in one seat, express bus 1003 stops at both Busan Station and the Haeundae Beach bus stop for ₩2,100. The details below come from Busan Transportation Corporation’s route search, fare table and timetables, Busan city’s fare pages, and the official Busan tourism site (visitbusan.net). I checked them on November 9, 2026.
